title: Chinh sach dat coc
content:
Chinh sach: Chinh sach dat coc
        Danh muc: Dat coc
        Noi dung: De dat xe, khach hang can dat coc 50% gia thue xe theo ngay. Tien coc se duoc hoan tra sau khi tra xe va kiem tra xe khong co hu hai.
        Dieu kien: Dat coc 50%, Hoan tra khi tra xe, Khong hu hai

title: Yeu cau giay to thue xe
content:
Chinh sach: Yeu cau giay to thue xe
        Danh muc: Giay to
        Noi dung: Khach hang can cung cap: 1) CMND/CCCD goc; 2) Giay phep lai xe (B2 tro len); 3) Ho khau hoac KT3; 4) Dat coc tien mat hoac the chap xe may.
        Dieu kien: CMND/CCCD, GPLX B2+, Ho khau/KT3, Dat coc

title: Cac loai phi phat sinh khi thue xe
content:
Chinh sach: Cac loai phi phat sinh khi thue xe
        Danh muc: Phi phat sinh
        Noi dung: Phi phat sinh bao gom: Phi vuot so km quy dinh (3.000 VND/km); Phi lai xe them (300.000 VND/ngay); Phi don xe neu tra xe ban (200.000 VND); Phi tre gio tra (gia thue/24 x so gio tre).
        Dieu kien: Vuot km: 3.000 VND/km, Lai xe them: 300.000 VND/ngay, Don xe: 200.000 VND, Tre gio: tinh theo gia thue

title: Bao hiem thue xe
content:
Chinh sach: Bao hiem thue xe
        Danh muc: Bao hiem
        Noi dung: Gia thue xe da bao gom bao hiem trach nhiem dan su. Khach hang co the mua them bao hiem vat chat (CDW) voi phi 10% gia thue/ngay de giam trach nhiem boi thuong khi xay ra tai nan.
        Dieu kien: Bao hiem TNDS: da bao gom, Bao hiem CDW: 10%/ngay

title: Chinh sach huy dat xe
content:
Chinh sach: Chinh sach huy dat xe
        Danh muc: Huy dat
        Noi dung: Chinh sach huy dat: Huy truoc 48 gio: hoan 100% tien coc; Huy truoc 24-48 gio: hoan 50% tien coc; Huy trong 24 gio: khong hoan tien coc. Truong hop bat kha khang duoc xem xet rieng.
        Dieu kien: 48h truoc: hoan 100%, 24-48h: hoan 50%, Duoi 24h: khong hoan

title: Chinh sach ban xe
content:
Chinh sach: Chinh sach ban xe
        Danh muc: Ban xe
        Noi dung: TMDT ho tro mua ban xe o to moi va cu voi gia canh tranh. Khach hang duoc ho tro vay mua xe voi lai suat uu dai 0% trong 12 thang (neu du dieu kien).
        Dieu kien: Gia canh tranh, Ho tro vay 0% 12 thang, Bao hanh chinh hang

title: Thue xe can nhung giay to gi?
content:
Cau hoi: Thue xe can nhung giay to gi?
        Tra loi: De thue xe, ban can chuan bi: CMND/CCCD goc, Giay phep lai xe (loai B2 tro len), va dat coc tien mat hoac the chap xe may. Neu ban la nguoi nuoc ngoai, can them ho chieu va visa valid.
        Danh muc: Thue xe
        Tu khoa: thue xe, giay to, dieu kien, CMND, GPLX

title: Gia thue xe co bao gom xang khong?
content:
Cau hoi: Gia thue xe co bao gom xang khong?
        Tra loi: Gia thue xe khong bao gom xang. Ban se nhan xe voi binh xang day va phai tra xe voi muc xang tuong duong. Neu tra xe thieu xang, phi se duoc tinh theo gia thi truong cong them 10%.
        Danh muc: Thue xe
        Tu khoa: thue xe, xang, gia thue, nhien lieu

title: Co the giao xe tan noi khong?
content:
Cau hoi: Co the giao xe tan noi khong?
        Tra loi: Co, TMDT ho tro giao xe tan noi trong noi thanh TP.HCM voi phi 100.000 VND. Voi cac tinh thanh khac, phi giao xe se duoc bao cu the theo khoang cach. Doi voi san bay, chung toi co dich vu don khach mien phi.
        Danh muc: Dich vu
        Tu khoa: giao xe, dia diem, don khach, san bay

title: Toi co the thue xe o dia diem khac de tra khong?
content:
Cau hoi: Toi co the thue xe o dia diem khac de tra khong?
        Tra loi: Co, ban co the thue va tra xe o cac dia diem khac nhau (one-way). Tuy nhien, se co phu thu one-way tu 200.000 - 500.000 VND tuy theo khoang cach. Vui long lien he truoc de duoc bao gia chinh xac.
        Danh muc: Thue xe
        Tu khoa: thue xe, tra xe, dia diem, one-way

title: Neu xe hong hoac gap su co trong qua trinh thue thi sao?
content:
Cau hoi: Neu xe hong hoac gap su co trong qua trinh thue thi sao?
        Tra loi: Neu xe gap su co, hay lien he ngay hotline 1900 xxxx. TMDT se ho tro 24/7. Trong truong hop xe khong the tiep tuc di chuyen, chung toi se xe den ho tro hoac thay the xe moi neu can thiet (mien phi neu loi tu phia cong ty).
        Danh muc: Ho tro
        Tu khoa: xe hong, su co, ho tro, hotline, 24/7

title: Toi co the thanh toan bang nhung phuong thuc nao?
content:
Cau hoi: Toi co the thanh toan bang nhung phuong thuc nao?
        Tra loi: TMDT chap nhan nhieu phuong thuc thanh toan: Tien mat, Chuyen khoan ngan hang, The Visa/Mastercard, Dien tu (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay). Doi voi hop dong dai han, co the thanh toan theo tuan/thang.
        Danh muc: Thanh toan
        Tu khoa: thanh toan, tien mat, chuyen khoan, the, vi dien tu

title: Co can tai xe khong?
content:
Cau hoi: Co can tai xe khong?
        Tra loi: Ban co the tu lai xe neu co GPLX phu hop. Neu muon co tai xe, chung toi cung cap dich vu tai xe voi phi 300.000 VND/ngay. Tai xe cua TMDT am hieu duong sa va thong thao tieng Anh neu can.
        Danh muc: Dich vu
        Tu khoa: tai xe, lai xe, dich vu, GPLX

title: Thue xe may co duoc khong?
content:
Cau hoi: Thue xe may co duoc khong?
        Tra loi: Hien tai TMDT chi cung cap dich vu thue o to (4 cho, 7 cho, xe sang). Neu ban can thue xe may, vui long lien he doi tac khac. Chung toi co the gioi thieu neu ban can.
        Danh muc: Thue xe
        Tu khoa: xe may, motor, thue xe, o to

title: Thoi gian mo cua cua TMDT?
content:
Cau hoi: Thoi gian mo cua cua TMDT?
        Tra loi: TMDT lam viec tu 8:00 - 20:00 tat ca cac ngay trong tuan (ke ca le, Tet). Dich vu ho tro khan cap 24/7 qua hotline. Ban co the dat xe online 24/7 va nhan xac nhan trong gio lam viec.
        Danh muc: Thong tin
        Tu khoa: gio lam viec, hotline, lien he, ho tro

title: Lam sao de dat xe?
content:
Cau hoi: Lam sao de dat xe?
        Tra loi: Ban co the dat xe theo cac cach sau: 1) Dat truc tiep tren website TMDT; 2) Goi hotline 1900 xxxx; 3) Den truc tiep van phong TMDT; 4) Nhan tin qua Zalo OA. Sau khi dat, ban se nhan duoc xac nhan va thong tin chi tiet qua SMS/Email.
        Danh muc: Dat xe
        Tu khoa: dat xe, booking, website, hotline, lien he
